subject.title: Feature request: add prefix/list-style skill discovery to ClawHub CLI search

question: Should ClawHub accept bounded `--prefix` and `--exact` search modes as the stable registry-discovery contract, or require cursor-pageable enumeration?
rationale: The issue asks for reliable enumeration and counting, while the linked PR proposes a new public CLI/API contract capped at 200 results; maintainers must define the intended completeness guarantee.

options.title: Approve bounded search modes
options.body: Accept the linked PR after real backend proof and document that exact and prefix results are capped rather than complete beyond 200 matches.

options.title: Require pageable enumeration
options.body: Redirect implementation to cursor-pageable slug filters on the skills listing API so namespace enumeration and counts can be complete.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded search modes
recommendation.body: Accept the linked PR after real backend proof and document that exact and prefix results are capped rather than complete beyond 200 matches.
